mechanism_narrative: A higher CPIAUCSL reading directly increases perceived inflation risk, triggering a market discount rate adjustment that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL > 240, or Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 20d returns falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, prompting immediate equity sell-offs as recession risk rises, producing negative S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC between UNRATE and 20d returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL above 240 indicate stagflation risk, causing amplified market panic and more severe negative S&P 500 returns than either signal alone over 20 days.
failure_condition: The negative return effect of the FEDFUNDS-CPIAUCSL interaction is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in 3-year rolling windows, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, HOUST declines below 1200 (thousands) signal housing market contraction, triggering recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25% and HOUST < 1200, or Rank IC for regime-conditional signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 100 (index) indicates manufacturing contraction, causing immediate equity market reaction and negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC between INDPRO and 5d returns is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS growth below 50 (thousand persons) signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending confidence and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of months with PAYEMS growth < 50, or Rank IC between PAYEMS growth and 20d returns is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During strong economic expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized), RSAFS above 470,000 (thousand dollars) signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances with GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and RSAFS > 470,000, or Rank IC for regime-conditional signal is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous UNRATE increases and PAYEMS growth declines indicate labor market deterioration, causing amplified recession fears and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The negative return effect of the UNRATE-PAYEMS interaction is not statistically significant (p>0.05) in 3-year rolling windows, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.03.
